description: Persistent semantic idea history used to suppress duplicate opportunities across daily radar runs.

ideas.core_job: For competition, award, publishing and event organizers, collect AI-use declarations and enforce configurable AI policies on submissions with review and evidence records.
ideas.product_mechanism: structured declaration + deterministic rule engine + human review queue + evidence record
source_titles: France's prestigious Goncourt prize drops novel after author accused of using AI

ideas.core_job: For marketing agencies and brand teams, determine and document required AI disclosure for each asset by platform and jurisdiction.
ideas.product_mechanism: asset register + jurisdiction/platform rule engine + approval workflow + evidence export
source_titles: SNS users want stronger AI-use disclosure

ideas.core_job: For AI auditors and security/compliance teams, validate TRACE Trust Records and convert them into human-readable audit evidence.
ideas.product_mechanism: browser JSON validator + signature verification + policy/tool summary + audit report
source_titles: AI agent audit evidence standardized with open TRACE specification

ideas.core_job: For property owners and managers, self-assess a building's digital-connectivity readiness before certification or investment.
ideas.product_mechanism: structured questionnaire + deterministic scoring + gap analysis + improvement report
source_titles: TRAI launches Digital Connectivity Rating Platform for properties

ideas.core_job: For brands and agencies, inventory printed QR assets and continuously detect broken, redirected or hijackable destinations.

ideas.product_mechanism: physical QR inventory + HTTP redirect monitoring + DNS/CNAME risk checks + alerting
source_titles: Abandoned QR code subdomains open to hijacking, researcher says
